# Local DWG conversion dependency

`@mlightcad/libredwg-web` **0.7.14**, unchanged npm distribution files.

- License: GPL-3.0 (see `COPYING` and the upstream license).
- Upstream wrapper/source: https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web
- Underlying converter/source: https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mlightcad/libredwg-web/v/0.7.14
- Download: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mlightcad/libredwg-web/-/libredwg-web-0.7.14.tgz
- Verified archive SHA-512 (base64): `5zuTw+x5o/qj9czjkcf2o3PWuh8v+XEEFM9ZEMEhVRaJySZ6+C7Ua6y6hyGcwJ3WfmXhWAHEdVYsKtx4XAlvfA==`

The worker loads only these same-origin files. It does not send drawings to a
conversion server. Conversion may be incomplete, especially text, blocks and
advanced entities. Keep source drawings and check converted output in CAD before
engineering use. This dependency does not certify the wall analysis.

Before redistributing/deploying a combined application, review GPL obligations,
including the corresponding-source requirements; this local prototype is not a
license-clearance statement.
